issue.title: Be more lenient with route arguments in AuthencationMiddleware 'requires' decorator

issue.body:
```
request = kwargs.get("request", args[idx])
```

should change to 

```
# first find request in kwargs
request = kwargs.get("request", None)
# second find request in args
if request is None and len(args) > 0:
     request = args[idx]
```
